title: Walnut Skillet Crunch
description: A crunchy and nutty skillet recipe perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the walnuts and nutty.
Add the spanish and salt, and mix well.
In a skillet, toast the nut mixture over medium heat for 2-3 minutes.
Add the sugar and mix until the sugar is caramelized.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 10-12 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool.
Once cooled, break the skillet into pieces and serve.
